notes.title: V1.5 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Happy 2018, everyone! We hope you’re still having a wonderful time playing HIVESWAP: Act 1 and exploring every last corner of Half-Harley Manor… and beyond! We have a new patch for you today, which addresses the following:

- AVPro has been updated, which should fix some crashes related to video playback that have been reported recently
- Fixes a bug that occurs when clicking on the Walkie-Talkie icon while simultaneously exiting a room

We hope this patch resolves any issues you may have encountered related to the above and apologize for any inconvenience caused in the interim. Thank you for your continued support of HIVESWAP: Act 1!

tags.bug: - AVPro has been updated, which should fix some crashes related to video playback that have been reported recently
- Fixes a bug that occurs when clicking on the Walkie-Talkie icon while simultaneously exiting a room

notes.title: V1.4 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Happy December, everyone! We hope you’re having a wonderful time exploring HIVESWAP: Act 1 and all that it has to offer, whether you’re about to start your first playthrough… or your fifth! And on that note, today’s new patch includes the following fixes and tweaks:

- Fixed a bug where giving milk to the deercat lusus would cause it to disappear, making further progress impossible
- Typo fixes

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the bug described above and hope this patch resolves the issue for those of you who encountered it. Thank you so much for your continued support of HIVESWAP: Act 1!

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where giving milk to the deercat lusus would cause it to disappear, making further progress impossible
- Typo fixes

notes.title: MINOR LINUX VERSION UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We can't thank you enough for your continued support of HIVESWAP: Act 1 and we hope you're having a blast with the game. We just pushed a minor update specifically for the Linux version of HIVESWAP: Act 1 that addresses the following issues:

- Fixed a bug related to the spice mix not appearing properly in the intro cutscene to the kitchen strife 

- Fixed a bug that would cause Joey to appear twice during the intro cutscene to the kitchen strife

That's all for today! We hope these bug fixes improve the gameplay experience for those Linux players who encountered them, and we apologize for any inconvenience they may have caused.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug related to the spice mix not appearing properly in the intro cutscene to the kitchen strife
- Fixed a bug that would cause Joey to appear twice during the intro cutscene to the kitchen strife

notes.title: V1.3 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
We promised it, you’ve been asking for it, and now it’s here – today’s new patch officially adds Linux support to HIVESWAP: Act 1!

That’s right, you read that correctly – Linux users, your time has come! We can’t thank you enough for your continued patience on this front, and we’re excited to deliver Linux support so more players can open the door and get started on their HIVESWAP adventure!

But the addition of Linux support isn’t the only update this patch brings. Here’s what we addressed in this patch:

- Linux support added
- In-game text will now only advance when you click the mouse, press the Enter key, or press the space bar, making it easy to take screenshots without further advancing the text
- Various typo fixes

Thank you so much for your continued support of HIVESWAP: Act 1 – we’re thrilled to see so many players continuing to enjoy the game and explore every last corner of it!

tags.bug: - In-game text will now only advance when you click the mouse, press the Enter key, or press the space bar, making it easy to take screenshots without further advancing the text
- Various typo fixes

notes.title: V1.2 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
We’ve got a new patch update ready for you, but first we’d like to say thank you all for your continued support! We love that you love the game and can’t wait for you to see what we have in store for upcoming acts!

Here’s what we fixed with this patch:

- Fixed a bug where players were accidentally switched to incorrect characters during cutscenes or entering minigames
- Minor art fixes
- Minor text and typo fixes
- Added missing item interactions
- Minor target ID fixes

notes.title: V1.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who helped make the launch of HIVESWAP: Act 1 a success! Your support means the world to us, and your enthusiasm for the game and the story we’re telling has been amazing. 

Since release day, we’ve been working on fixes for some cutscene and resolution issues players have been experiencing. We have released a patch that should address these issues for most players. 

Here is some of what was changed in this patch: 

Cutscene playback improvements
Changes to resolution on first run of game
More resolution options available in video dropdown
Various text fixes
Strife white-screen hang fixed
Basement tablet interaction issues fixed
